{{Top|leg}}
'''Sensor masks''' were devices added to [[Starship/Legends|starships]] so that they would be more difficult for other vessels to detect. 
==Characteristics==
When active, sensor masks monitored the sensor conditions around a ship, and superimposed these signals on top of the ship's sensor profile. This fooled sensor scans into seeing a single and uninterrupted section of space - and allowed ships to operate extremely close to sensors and scanners without being detected electronically - though it did nothing against visual detection.

==History==
The [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]] [[4-LOM/Legends|4-LOM]] and [[Zuckuss/Legends|Zuckuss]] had a sensor mask installed on their ship, the [[Mist Hunter/Legends|''Mist Hunter'']].
